description: This file defines the PersistableImage class, which represents an image with associated metadata such as byte data, content type, and image name, used within the product catalog module of the application.

classes.name: PersistableImage
classes.description: A Java class encapsulating image data, including the image bytes, content type, and image name, used for storing and retrieving product images.

methods.name: setBytes
methods.description: Sets the byte array representing the image data.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Retrieves the byte array of the image data.

methods.name: setContentType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Retrieves the MIME type of the image.

methods.name: setImageName
methods.description: Sets the name of the image.

methods.name: getImageName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the image.
